_comment: Hand-written. One concise description per registered enchantment, condensed from the Horizon 0.6 Enchantment Guide (2026-11-27 inspection of the installed jars/configs). scripts/gen_enchant_tooltips.py writes them as enchantment.<ns>.<id>.desc lang keys into kubejs/assets/<ns>/lang/en_us.json; Apothic Enchanting shows them under each enchantment (Enable Inlined Enchantment Descriptions = true, scripts/patch_configs.py).

descriptions.apothic_enchanting:berserkers_fury: When hurt, may enrage you: Strength, Resistance and Speed for 25 s at a health cost. 45 s cooldown. Curse.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:boon_of_the_earth: Mining stone, deepslate or Nether stone can drop bonus ores. Higher levels raise the chance.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:chainsaw: Axe fells the whole connected tree at once.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:chromatic: Sheared wool comes out in a random color.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:crescendo_of_bolts: Fire extra crossbow shots before reloading; +1 shot per level.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:endless_quiver: Bow uses no arrows at all, any kind. Not with Infinity.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:growth_serum: Sheared sheep have a 50% chance to regrow wool instantly.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:icy_thorns: Attackers may get a long Slowness; chance and strength scale with level. Not with Thorns.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:knowledge_of_the_ages: Item drops from your kills become XP instead (the items are lost).
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:life_mending: Healing you receive repairs enchanted gear instead, reducing your healing. Better repair per level. Curse; not with Mending.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:miners_fervor: Large mining-speed boost, but blocks can never break instantly. Not with Efficiency.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:natures_blessing: Right-click crops to bonemeal them using hoe durability; less durability per level.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:rebounding: Melee attackers are knocked away and upward; stronger per level.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:reflective_defenses: Shield blocks can reflect part of the damage to the attacker; chance and share rise per level.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:scavenger: Kills have +2.5% per level to roll the mob's loot an extra time.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:shield_bash: Attacking with the shield deals bonus damage, costing shield durability.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:tempting: Farm animals follow you while you hold this hoe.
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:worker_exploitation: Shearing gives double wool but hurts the sheep.
descriptions.apothic_spawners:capturing: Kills have a chance to drop the mob's spawn egg; higher levels raise the chance.
descriptions.ars_nouveau:mana_boost: +25 max mana per level per armor piece.
descriptions.ars_nouveau:mana_regen: +2 mana regeneration per level per armor piece.
descriptions.ars_nouveau:reactive: Chance to cast the item's inscribed spell when used or when you are hurt. Needs a spell inscribed.
descriptions.create:potato_recovery: Potato Cannon ammo has a chance not to be used up.
descriptions.deeperdarker:catalysis: Kills spread sculk around the victim, like a sculk catalyst.
descriptions.deeperdarker:sculk_smite: +2.5 damage per level to sculk mobs (Warden, Shattered).
descriptions.deeperdarker:volume: Sonorous Staff blasts deal more damage.
descriptions.nova_structures:antidote: Immune to magic damage (e.g. potions); poison wears down the chestplate.
descriptions.nova_structures:piercing: Bow arrows pass through multiple entities. Not with Infinity or Mending.
descriptions.nova_structures:conductivity_curse: During thunderstorms under open sky, lightning may strike you. Curse.
descriptions.nova_structures:ghasted: Crossbow arrows explode in fire on impact (can break blocks); slower charge.
descriptions.nova_structures:gravity: Crossbow arrow impacts pull nearby entities in; stronger per level.
descriptions.nova_structures:illagers_bane: +2.5 damage per level against illagers and related mobs.
descriptions.nova_structures:power: Might: crossbow arrows deal more damage.
descriptions.nova_structures:outreach: +0.5 block-interaction reach per level (not attack reach).
descriptions.nova_structures:photosynthesis: Slowly repairs itself in clear daylight under open sky. Not with Mending.
descriptions.nova_structures:traveler: Sprinting on ground: faster and steps up small ledges; occasional boot wear. Not with Soul Speed.
descriptions.nova_structures:multishot: Tri-Shot: bow fires 3 arrows in a spread. Not with Infinity or Mending.
descriptions.nova_structures:wax_wings: Elytra no longer wears normally, but fast flight (worst in high, sunny skies) damages it. Not with Unbreaking.
descriptions.nova_structures:wither_coated: Hits inflict Wither for 8-10 s; extra weapon wear. Not with Fire Aspect.
descriptions.farmersdelight:backstabbing: Knife hits from behind deal x1.4 damage, +0.2 per extra level.
descriptions.minecraft:bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage to spiders, silverfish and endermites, and slows them.
descriptions.minecraft:blast_protection: Reduces explosion damage and knockback. Not with Fire/Projectile Protection.
descriptions.minecraft:breach: Mace hits ignore part of the target's armor; more per level.
descriptions.minecraft:channeling: Thrown trident summons lightning on a hit during thunderstorms (target under open sky).
descriptions.minecraft:binding_curse: Cannot be unequipped until it breaks or you die. Curse.
descriptions.minecraft:vanishing_curse: Disappears instead of dropping when you die. Curse.
descriptions.minecraft:density: Mace smash attacks deal extra damage per block fallen.
descriptions.minecraft:depth_strider: Move faster underwater. Not with Frost Walker.
descriptions.minecraft:efficiency: Mines faster with the right tool. Not with Miner's Fervor.
descriptions.minecraft:fire_aspect: Melee hits set the target on fire; longer burn per level.
descriptions.minecraft:fire_protection: Reduces fire damage and burn time. Not with Blast/Projectile Protection.
descriptions.minecraft:flame: Bow arrows are on fire and ignite targets.
descriptions.minecraft:fortune: More drops from ores, crops and similar blocks. Not with Silk Touch.
descriptions.minecraft:frost_walker: Freezes water under your feet into ice; no magma-block damage. Not with Depth Strider.
descriptions.minecraft:impaling: Trident deals extra damage to aquatic mobs.
descriptions.minecraft:infinity: Normal arrows are not used up (need one in inventory). Not with Mending.
descriptions.minecraft:knockback: Melee hits knock targets farther back.
descriptions.minecraft:looting: Mobs you kill drop more loot and rare drops more often.
descriptions.minecraft:loyalty: Thrown trident returns to you; faster per level. Not with Riptide.
descriptions.minecraft:mending: Collected XP repairs this item instead of going to you.
descriptions.minecraft:multishot: Crossbow fires 3 projectiles for 1 ammo. Not with Piercing.
descriptions.minecraft:piercing: Crossbow arrows pass through more entities and shields per level. Not with Multishot.
descriptions.minecraft:projectile_protection: Reduces projectile damage. Not with Blast/Fire Protection.
descriptions.minecraft:protection: Reduces most incoming damage. Stacks with the specialized protections in Horizon.
descriptions.minecraft:punch: Bow arrows knock targets back farther.
descriptions.minecraft:riptide: Using the trident in water or rain launches you forward. Not with Loyalty or Channeling.
descriptions.minecraft:sharpness: Extra melee damage against everything. Combines with Smite/Bane in Horizon.
descriptions.minecraft:silk_touch: Blocks drop themselves instead of their normal drops. Not with Fortune.
descriptions.minecraft:soul_speed: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil; occasional boot wear.
descriptions.minecraft:sweeping_edge: Sword sweep attacks deal more damage to nearby targets.
descriptions.minecraft:thorns: Chance to damage attackers, at a durability cost. Not with Icy Thorns.
descriptions.minecraft:unbreaking: Chance to not lose durability on use.
descriptions.minecraft:wind_burst: A mace smash launches you back up for chained attacks; higher per level.
descriptions.occultism:fracture_soul: Kills have a chance to drop a Shattered Soul Shard.
descriptions.supplementaries:carousel: Quiver/lunch basket cycles to the next arrow or food in order. Not with Whimsy.
descriptions.supplementaries:stasis: Slingshot shots ignore gravity; Bubble Blower bubbles become lasting blocks. Not with Multishot.
descriptions.supplementaries:whimsy: Quiver/lunch basket picks the next arrow or food at random. Not with Carousel.
descriptions.the_bumblezone:comb_cutter: Breaks combs, hives and wax blocks faster and gets more from bee nests.
descriptions.the_bumblezone:hive_lifeline: A nearby bee (16 blocks) takes an attack for you; 4 s cooldown.
descriptions.the_bumblezone:neurotoxins: Stinger Spear hits can paralyze (not undead or golems; harder on high-health mobs); extra wear.
descriptions.the_bumblezone:potent_poison: Spear/trident hits poison the target; stronger and longer per level (not undead).
descriptions.undergarden:ricochet: Slingshot ammo bounces off blocks. Not with Self Sling.
descriptions.undergarden:self_sling: Slingshot launches you instead of ammo (must stand on ground). Not with Ricochet.
descriptions.dungeons_arise:lolths_curse: Hits may give Regeneration but spawn cave spiders; hitting arthropods hurts you; Darkness on players. Curse.
descriptions.dungeons_arise:discharge: Hits stack Speed; at max stacks the next hit releases a lightning burst that can also hurt you.
descriptions.dungeons_arise:ensnaring: Hits may heavily slow the target and summon evoker fangs; chance per level.
descriptions.dungeons_arise:purification: When poisoned or withered, may cleanse it and release a damaging burst; chance per level.
descriptions.dungeons_arise:voltaic_shot: Crossbow arrows fly straight and burst with electric explosions (no block damage).
descriptions.apothic_enchanting:infusion: Internal marker for Apothic infusion crafting. No effect on gear.
descriptions.nova_structures:shulker_miniboss: Boss-only marker: victims get Levitation III for 5 s. Not obtainable gear.
descriptions.nova_structures:boss_behaviour: Boss-only marker for Dungeons and Taverns bosses. Not obtainable gear.
descriptions.nova_structures:shulker_boss: Boss-only marker: victims get Levitation II for 15 s. Not obtainable gear.
